title: Add or edit action
purpose: Add an action to a nonconformance with the person who does it and a due date, or change an open action with a reason.
summary: Add an action to a nonconformance with who does it and by when, or change an open action's text, person or due date with a reason.

tasks.title: Add an action
steps: Describe it in [[Action]], choose the [[Person]] and the [[Due date]], and select [[Add action]].

tasks.title: Change an open action
steps: Open the action's [[Actions]] menu and select [[Edit action]].
Make the change, explain it in [[Reason]] and select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: A new or changed due date must be today or later. An existing due date already past may stay as it is.
Editing an action needs a reason. It is kept with the change in the record's history.
Only an open action can be edited. A done or cancelled action stays as it was.
The person can mark the action done even if they do not own the record.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Add action under Actions, or Edit action in an action's menu, on the record, as a dialog or a full page. Only the owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it; anyone else is refused. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

sections.title: Adding and editing
paragraphs: Add action starts empty, has no Reason field, and its button reads Add action. Edit action starts with the action's text, person and due date, notes that a due date already past may stay as it is while a new one is today or later, asks for a Reason, and its button reads Save changes. Adding an action, or changing one, clears a recorded effectiveness check: the work it covered has changed, so it is recorded again before closing. The history keeps the earlier check.

items.label: Action
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. What is to be done.

items.label: Person
items.description: Required. Who does it. Lists active staff accounts; the person must be an active account with a staff role, otherwise: Choose an active staff member as the person who does it.

items.label: Due date
items.description: Required. Today or later. When editing, an unchanged due date already past is accepted; a changed one must be today or later: Choose today or a later date.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Edit only, required. Kept with the change in the record's history.

items.label: Add action
items.description: Adds the action as Open and confirms Action added. The history records Action added with its due date and person.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Saves the edit and confirms Action saved. The history records Action edited with your reason, and the due date and person before and after when they changed.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without changing anything.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: An edit that changes nothing: Change at least one detail before saving. An action already done or cancelled: Only an open action changes. A closed record: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Your input is kept on the form. A change to any of the record's actions counts as a change to the record.

items.label: Signed out by a time limit
items.description: When a time limit signs you out, what you typed here is kept for 24 hours, for you in that browser only, and comes back on this page when you sign in again there (a form open in a dialog opens again on its own page). It keeps the version of the record you typed against: if the record changed since, the page says This record changed after you typed it, and saving is refused with your typing on the form. Copy what you need, then select Discard on the notice, or after a refused save open the form again from the record, to see the record as it stands. It comes back even where the form is no longer offered, for example after the record was closed. A person chosen comes back only while their account is still an active staff account.
